text:
Anya: Quick straw-poll — if you could permanently ban one buzzword from all company meetings, what would it be? :grimacing:
Tomas: "low-hanging fruit" — instantly lose brain points whenever I hear it. :sweat_smile:
Lina: "circle back" for sure. feels like an eternal postponement spell. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Samir: My vote goes to "deep-dive". Nobody actually dives, we just tread water. :swimming_man::sweat_drops:
Harriet: "synergy". it's the corporate word salad champion. :trophy:
Anya: @Samir hahah this thread is basically a blacklist in the making. Also accepting multi-word combos like "quick win" or "move the needle".
Tomas: Ooh add "touch base". It implies we should schedule another meeting about scheduling. :calendar:
Lina: Can we have a tiered ban? like loud buzwords (instant mute) and soft buzz (gently discouraged).
Samir: ops-bot, can you add a rule to #meeting-ops: whenever someone says a banned buzzword, react with :no_entry_sign:? :robot_face:
ops-bot: Auto-rule suggestion: If a message contains any of ["synergy","circle back","touch base","move the needle","deep-dive","low-hanging fruit"], react with :no_entry_sign:. Would you like me to enable it in #all-hands for a week? (yes/no)
Harriet: Yes please. Let's trial it in #all-hands — prices of meetings are rising. :money_with_wings:
Anya: If enabled, I promise to bring fresh cookies to the first meeting where someone slips up. :cookie:
Tomas: Deal. If I say "synergy" accidentally I'll order the cookies and deliver. :raised_hand:
Lina: Also willing to be the official buzzword librarian and issue citations. We'll need an official list and a cheeky badge. :books::medal_military:
Samir: Badge = excellent incentive. Also if someone gets muted by ops-bot, they have to explain themselves in 140 characters or less.
Harriet: Thread result: unanimous-ish. "Synergy" gets top ban votes. Let's see what ops-bot recommends. :eyes:
